market.summary: Indian markets were shut today for Guru Nanak Jayanti, so Monday's close still sets every stop. Overnight the US had a big relief rally (Nasdaq +6.5%) after Nvidia reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO, which pauses last week's AI-led sell-off and should help Wednesday's open after Monday's 1.75% Nifty fall. Foreign investors kept buying on Monday while domestic funds sold.

points.text: US, Mon 23 Nov: Dow +3.0% to 49,595, S&P 500 +4.7%, Nasdaq +6.5%; Nvidia +31% after its board reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO, Micron +19%. The S&P had fallen 8.6% the week before.
NSE and BSE were closed on Tue 24 Nov (Guru Nanak Jayanti); trading resumes Wednesday 25 Nov.
Mon 23 Nov provisional cash flows: FIIs bought Rs 5,673 Cr, DIIs sold Rs 2,760 Cr; FIIs have bought 10 sessions in a row (Rs 33,455 Cr over 5 days).
US October PCE inflation is due Wednesday 25 Nov (US time), a risk for a second leg of the rally.
